projectDescription: Friday Night Funkin' is an open-source rhythm game built with HaxeFlixel, featuring a full chart editor, a Polymod-based modding system, and multi-platform support including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and HTML5.
keyFeatures: Full rhythm gameplay with 4-key strumlines, BPM sync, and multiple difficulty levels
Polymod-based modding system supporting custom songs, characters, stages, and scripts
Built-in Chart Editor (FNFC format) with audio import, variations, and export
PBOT1 timing-based scoring with Sick/Good/Bad/Shit judgements and rank system
Multi-platform builds: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and HTML5
Scripted class system allowing mods to extend HaxeFlixel types via HScript
Song variations system for Erect/Nightmare difficulty alternate tracks
Conductor class for precise musical timing with BPM change support
Tracy profiling integration and comprehensive debug hotkey system
Discord Rich Presence, screenshot capture, and hot-reload asset support
publicApiSurface: Conductor.instance — singleton providing beat/step/measure signals and song position
Conductor.beatHit / stepHit / measureHit — FlxSignal hooks for musical timing
Preferences — static fields: framerate, downscroll, naughtyness, ghostTapping, etc.
PolymodHandler — loads and manages Polymod mods from the mods/ directory
IScriptedClass / ScriptedModule — HScript-based mod scripting interface
ScriptedFlxSprite, ScriptedFlxState, ScriptedFlxSubState, etc. — scriptable base classes
ScriptedCharacter, ScriptedStage, ScriptedBopper, ScriptedSong — game object scripting
Song metadata JSON schema (version 2.2.2): songName, artist, timeChanges, playData
Chart data JSON schema (version 2.0.0): note data, song events per variation
FNFC file format — ZIP bundle containing manifest.json, audio .ogg files, metadata and chart JSON
_polymod_meta.json — mod manifest: title, description, api_version, mod_version, license
lime test <platform> — primary build command (windows, mac, linux, html5, android, ios)
